narrative.overview: A centered 800px reading page containing Jiaxin Xu's name, two biography paragraphs, direct email and GitHub links, and three equally weighted publications. White, dark gray, and blue links keep the interface quiet. Source Sans 3 is the only web font. Authentic 176px paper thumbnails accompany desktop entries; mobile entries use Figure links. The page needs no runtime JavaScript. This direction replaces the promotional hero, repeated research and project sections, and colored bands that the user rejected.
keyCharacteristics: A recognizable person and academic background before the papers.
One compact publication list with direct paper and code/model links.
Small source-derived desktop thumbnails and text-first mobile entries.
Document-like restraint informed by Jon Barron's and Andrej Karpathy's personal homepages.
dos: State personal and research facts once, in the biography or corresponding publication.
Preserve authentic paper titles, author order, venue information, and primary resource URLs.
Keep visible keyboard focus, semantic headings, responsive reflow, and 44px contact/resource targets.
donts: Do not add promotional slogans, hero actions, featured-paper marketing layouts, or colored section bands.
Do not repeat paper and biography facts in separate news, research, project, education, or contact sections.
Do not add cards, gradients, ornamental motion, or application controls.
Do not invent a portrait, undergraduate dates, a degree abbreviation, or other unsupported facts.
